lines.text: He unleashed His fury against them,
He cleared a path for His anger;
He did not spare them from death
but delivered their lives to the plague.
He struck all the firstborn of Egypt,
the virility in the tents of Ham.
He led out His people like sheep
and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
He led them safely, so they did not fear,
but the sea engulfed their enemies.
He brought them to His holy land,
to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
He drove out nations before them
He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.

pictures.scene: George Stubbs, Horse Frightened by a Lion — the horse thrown back on itself as the lion comes out of the rock, He unleashed His fury against them, wrath indignation and calamity
pictures.name: pd_stubbs_horse_frightened_by_a_lion

pictures.scene: Evelyn De Morgan, The Angel of Death — the winged one come for the soul it was sent to take, a band of destroying angels, He cleared a path for His anger
pictures.name: pd_demorgan_angel_of_death

pictures.scene: Hans Heyerdahl, The Dying Child — the child laid down with the sickness on it and nothing left to try, He did not spare them from death, but delivered their lives to the plague
pictures.name: pd_heyerdahl_dying_child

pictures.scene: Ernst Koerner, Ägyptischer Abendhimmel — the evening coming down over Egypt the night everything changed, He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham
pictures.name: pd_koerner_aegyptischer_abendhimmel

pictures.scene: Árpád Feszty, The Arrival of the Hungarians — the whole people on the move together with their herds and their households, He led out His people like sheep, and guided them like a flock in the wilderness
pictures.name: pd_feszty_arrival_of_the_hungarians

pictures.scene: Auguste Mayer, Fragata Constituição — the ship carrying all those souls through under a hard sky, He led them safely so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies
pictures.name: pd_mayer_fragata_constituicao

pictures.scene: Thomas Seddon, Jerusalem and the Valley of Jehoshaphat — the holy city seen across the valley on its own hill, He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired
pictures.name: pd_seddon_jerusalem_jehoshaphat

pictures.scene: Charles-François Daubigny, Harvest — the fields cut and the sheaves divided up across the whole plain, He drove out nations before them, and apportioned their inheritance
pictures.name: pd_daubigny_harvest

pictures.scene: Andrei Ryabushkin, A Moscow Street on a Holiday — the people settled in their own streets and keeping the day, He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents, but they tested and disobeyed God Most High
pictures.name: pd_ryabushkin_moscow_street_holiday
